name: Tanuki-kun no Haru Sanpo
original_name: タヌキくんの春さんぽ
source:
You get a letter from your fox friend, Kitsune, on a pleasant spring morning.

It's time to go on a walk!🌸

A novel game stroll which you play by making choices. Pick up ingredients on the way to Kitsune's house.

[From [url=https://satoyama-note.itch.io/spring-walk-of-tanuki]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个宜人的春天早晨，你收到了一封来自你的狐狸朋友狐的信。

是时候去散步了！🌈

一款通过做出选择来玩的新颖游戏。在去狐家的路上捡起食材。

[来自[url=https://satoyama-note.itch.io/spring-walk-of-tanuki]itch.io[/url]]
